content.text: {"sections":[{"section":"summary","body":"Orbitline Systems met all three covenants on the Venture Term Loan for the period ended October 31, 2026, and the compliance certificate agrees with the bank's calculation on each. The most notable development is the steady narrowing of cushion on the minimum unrestricted cash covenant, now {{fact:1e2a444b-ad46-4bff-b9c2-eb3b87211055}}, which the bank's monitoring flagged as a low-severity signal indicating ongoing cash burn. No other signal fired and no work items are open. Nothing on the sheet currently awaits a decision."},{"section":"covenants","body":"Minimum Runway was calculated at {{fact:b4fc4dba-f28b-4384-af24-5ad3732b24fd}} against a required {{fact:788e5c23-c2dc-433c-a86b-727ae4a35e2b}}, a cushion of {{fact:54e325a6-e8a3-4987-98cd-8748c0820680}}. Minimum Unrestricted Cash was {{fact:17e92191-36ba-45ac-a5d5-1a5ea8b346f7}} against a floor of {{fact:4b28462c-0a45-4cbf-8e93-33a6a6f4bb0b}}, a cushion of {{fact:1e2a444b-ad46-4bff-b9c2-eb3b87211055}}. Revenue to Plan was {{fact:ff6fb278-d06c-411a-b2b8-baf477274e6f}} against a required {{fact:f04371cc-5ed5-4e8c-a83d-b3a0b0129658}}, a cushion of {{fact:6a1842f4-bfa3-4966-94df-b2546b388ea5}}. Each covenant is compliant, and the certificate figures ({{fact:04b57f74-cae8-4cd5-9d5b-19a59ea1d00e}}, {{fact:668a61f4-ba0d-4ef4-81bb-baa9f9e50322}} and {{fact:68ee061e-2632-4ecf-9c87-060cb0379ed3}}) match the bank's calculations."},{"section":"risks","body":"One early warning signal fired, rated low severity: headroom on the minimum unrestricted cash covenant has narrowed in each month from August through October, reaching {{fact:1e2a444b-ad46-4bff-b9c2-eb3b87211055}} with cash of {{fact:17e92191-36ba-45ac-a5d5-1a5ea8b346f7}} against the {{fact:4b28462c-0a45-4cbf-8e93-33a6a6f4bb0b}} floor. Cash remains above the requirement, but the trend is consistent with continuing burn, and a reviewer may wish to consider it alongside the runway result. No other signal corroborates it, and there are no open work items awaiting action."}]}
